downloads.title: Downloaded Wallpapers
downloads.subtitle: Local wallpapers on this device. Active content permissions apply here too.
downloads.empty: No downloaded wallpapers yet. Download one from Explore.

filters.permissions_desc: Applied using each source’s rating metadata. Selecting categories never enables sensitive ratings.
filters.sfw_desc: Images marked safe by the source.
filters.explicit_desc: Off by default. Wallhaven requires an API key for this rating.
filters.unknown_desc: Museum archives and local folders do not include rating tags and require this permission.
filters.remember_sensitive_desc: When off, every new window starts in SFW-only mode.
filters.specs_desc: Minimum pixel size, orientation, and file format rules.

settings.undo_last_desc: Restores the previous light and dark wallpaper pair.
settings.language_desc: Defaults to Turkish; 10 languages are built in.
settings.language_changed_toast: Language updated. Reopen preferences to refresh all tabs.
settings.history_desc: Off by default. Turning it off clears saved queries.
settings.cache_desc: Shared 256 MiB thumbnail and preview cache. No background service runs when closed.
settings.export_diag_desc: Last 256 events; contains no images or API keys.
settings.shortcuts_desc: Ctrl+F: search · Ctrl+1–4: tabs · Lightbox: wheel zoom · drag pan · right-click menu · ←/→ browse · I: info · 0/1: fit/100%

about.comments: Multi-source wallpaper gallery and adaptive OKLab color engine for GNOME.
about.ack_body: Designed and verified through an AI-assisted development (vibe coding) workflow

colors.group_theme_desc: Generates adaptive colors for GNOME Shell, the top bar, and apps from your light and dark wallpapers.
colors.enable_desc: Works even without User Themes; avoid running alongside another Shell theme manager.
colors.panel_group_desc: Instantly adjust top-bar readability in both light and dark modes.
colors.style_capsule_desc: Ambient-tinted glass pills in both light and dark modes.
colors.style_smart_desc: Uses adaptive ink over clean regions and automatic capsules over busy regions.
colors.style_scrim_desc: Applies a soft gradient scrim behind the transparent top bar to balance contrast.
colors.style_plain_desc: Adjusts each item’s ink color directly against the wallpaper without capsules or scrim.
colors.strength_subtle_desc: More translucent glass pills that keep the wallpaper front and center.
colors.strength_balanced_desc: Balanced contrast and refined translucency for everyday wallpapers.
colors.strength_crisp_desc: Strongest separation and maximum contrast over very detailed wallpapers.
colors.compare_prompt: Compare the light and dark previews above, then save your preferred character.
colors.prepare_prompt: Generate palettes to preview colors from your current wallpapers.
colors.wallpapers_desc_gallery: Each button updates only the theme mode shown on its label.
colors.wallpapers_desc_store: Change your wallpapers in GNOME Settings and Duvar updates palettes automatically.
colors.layers_group_desc: Choose which desktop layers receive your adaptive wallpaper palette.
colors.follow_desc: Automatically re-extracts colors using your saved character whenever a wallpaper changes.
colors.gtk_desc: Applies matching light and dark palettes to GTK 3 and classic GTK 4 apps.
colors.adwaita_desc: GTK 4.12+ · Adds a clean, reversible import to your user GTK 4 CSS.
colors.adwaita_refresh_desc: Briefly pulses high-contrast mode to reload CSS in already-open Libadwaita apps.
colors.toast_saved_enable: Palette saved. Enable Use Duvar Theme to apply it.
colors.profile_0_desc: Main wallpaper hue with measured saturation and crisp surfaces.
colors.profile_1_desc: Soft milky surfaces, powdery cards, and gentle selections.
colors.profile_2_desc: Rich accent color, tinted borders, and expressive states.
colors.profile_3_desc: Clay and stone tones with warm matte surfaces.
colors.profile_4_desc: Blue-leaning edges with crisp, airy cool surfaces.
colors.profile_5_desc: Amber-leaning details with creamy warm surfaces.
colors.profile_6_desc: Neighboring hue: wallpaper tint on surfaces, adjacent hue on focus.
colors.profile_7_desc: Deeper base, grounded accent, and bold layer separation.
colors.profile_8_desc: Subdued stone tones and calmer transitions.
colors.profile_9_desc: Neutral surfaces and controls separated purely by luminance.
